verdict.rationale: CDP documents a few configurable rules that run on their own. Deposit destinations auto-credit incoming funds, and they can be set as liquidation addresses that convert funds before crediting. The SDK also supports USDC subscriptions with spend permissions. These are narrow, payment-specific behaviors rather than a general automation capability, and agent wallet actions are agent-invoked rather than scheduled. Missing for 10: a general automation or workflow builder, scheduled or recurring payouts, documentation of how subscriptions execute in the background, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: When a deposit arrives, the corresponding account's balance is credited automatically.
A destination can also act as a liquidation address, automatically converting incoming funds into a different asset before crediting the account.
Create USDC subscriptions with spend permissions on Base network
